# gramlot-py-server 0.3.24

Consolidates environment collection discovery, PageStore/WebSocket integration and the database gallery support with the matching core and examples packages.

The Base Asqueel host includes the experimental typed JSONL route using ordinary page ownership and endpoint authorization. The opt-in cached-selection gallery confines cache writes to its separately configured cache schema. Database examples require the documented database and role setup; installing this package does not create those permissions.

Invoice application and TestFlight publication are excluded. Remote Edit remains disabled in the public gallery profile.
